protocol: E criterion v2 (plan: E 准则修正版)
registered_before: any v2 validation result (static, injection, Moco test split) and any v2 score of e4 / x3 / m1 / e1; tau values are frozen into this file from the Moco calibration split before any of these is computed
decided_by: user: fix the defects (e_v2); floor reference by per-method convention audit (audit); tau from 24 Moco references split by subject 12 / 12 (m24)
baseline: v1 = config/e_criterion_domain_20261105.json; v1 results are reported unchanged next to v2
principle: v1 parameters were seen on v1 validation data, so no v2 parameter is tuned on them; v2 is validated on newly drawn data (seed 20261106)
changes_from_v1: world floor: each method's own floor convention (config/e_v2_floor_reference_20261106.json) instead of the per-run 5th-percentile floor
absolute contact: one world floor for all four landmarks; a landmark is in contact when its height above its flat-foot standing reference is <= the margin
tau: re-derived inside the model from dynamically consistent Moco references (calibration split only)

contact.elevation: height of the landmark (heel = calcn origin, toe = toes origin of the scaled model, OpenSim Y-up) minus reference_m[variant][side][landmark]
contact.rule: contact if elevation <= 0.03 m (margin carried over from v1, 约定，未经推演)
contact.velocity_components: R0 height only; R4 also horizontal speed <= 1.2 m/s; R5 onset rule 0.5 m/s, exactly as in v1; R0 is primary, R4 and R5 are the bracket
contact.grf_points: the sole points of contacting landmarks placed on the world floor plane (world_floor_m)
contact.references: config/e_v2_floor_reference_20261106.json: generated methods by run_mapping; kin30 human clips by the subject leave-one-trial-out reference; Moco references reference_m = floor_m of the solve, world floor floor_m - 0.03
contact.without_reference: scored with v1 contact and reported with relative metrics only; no generated method lacks a reference at registration; kin30 trials without a subject reference are excluded from v2 human validation

depth.lowest_elevation: per frame, the minimum elevation over the four landmarks (m); reported as median, p5, p95 over scored frames
depth.hover_share: share of scored frames with lowest_elevation > +0.03 m (no landmark within the contact margin)
depth.penetration_share: share of scored frames with lowest_elevation < -0.03 m (约定，未经推演: symmetric with the margin)
depth.role: an independent report quantity, not part of the envelope verdict

tau.source: the 12 calibration references of config/e_v2_moco_refs_20261106.json, each solved by python/scripts/e_v2_moco_refs.py and evaluated with contact_v2 (python/scripts/e_domain_moco.py --evaluate, frames_v2.npz)
tau.frames: scored frames after E's 0.5 s trim at each end
tau.states: amendment 3: event = within 40 ms of a foot contact change, contact, flight (e_rules.states)
tau.value: tau[rule][state] = 99th percentile of residual_bw over the calibration frames pooled in that state
tau.sparse_state: a state with fewer than 30 pooled calibration frames takes the v1 tau of that rule and state, flagged in tau_source
tau.failures: failed calibration solves are not replaced; tau uses the successful ones; fewer than 6 successful calibration references: v2 is reported as not calibratable and stops here
tau.verdict: frame infeasible if residual_bw > tau[rule][state of the frame]; envelope_infeasible_share = mean over scored frames (as v1)

static.poses: 216 new poses: human kin30 trials that have a subject reference, classes stand, squat, sts, wholebody, walk, jump, 8 trials x 2 frames each (trials not in the v1 static draw; all eligible if fewer than 8); generated: valid e4 runs, 6 runs x 2 frames per method (runs not in the v1 static draw); frames drawn from the middle half; plus 24 whole-pose vertical offsets of these poses: 12 at +0.05 m and 12 at -0.05 m
static.hold: as v1: pose repeated 2 s at 30 fps, full pipeline, 0.5 s trim, mass 75 kg

truth.foot_outline_m: as v1 (heel vertices calcn origin -0.03 forward, +-0.035 lateral; toe vertices toes origin +0.05 forward, +-0.04 lateral)
truth.vertex_elevation: heel vertices take the heel landmark elevation, toe vertices the toe landmark elevation (the reference is the flat-foot standing height, so both are heights above the method floor)
truth.support: vertices with elevation <= 0.03 m (the contact margin, so that truth and E agree on which feet can carry load and the static test isolates balance; 约定，未经推演); sensitivity with 0.01 m reported
truth.margin_and_label: as v1: signed distance of the COM ground projection to the hull of the supporting vertices, mean over trimmed frames; feasible >= +0.02, infeasible <= -0.02 or no support, else indeterminate
truth.categories: balance (support exists), unsupported (no supporting vertex), penetrating (lowest elevation < -0.03 m)

injection.bases: the 12 Moco test references (truth feasible: their solved model markers resampled to 30 fps form the motion; reference = floor_m; mass = trial mass) and 12 human kin30 clips (6 walk, 6 sts; rng 20261106) that were not v1 injection bases, are not among the 24 Moco references and have a subject reference; human clips cropped to at most 6 s around the centre as in v1
injection.defects: the v1 kinds and sizes (float_window_m 0.02/0.05/0.10, float_whole_m 0.10, penetrate_window_m 0.02/0.05/0.10, lean_deg 5/10/20, slide_m_s 0.1/0.3/0.6 with slide_max_s 0.5, time_compression 1.25/1.5/2.0) plus float_whole_m 0.02/0.05 and penetrate_whole_m 0.02/0.05/0.10 for the whole-clip criterion
injection.window: as v1 (middle third with 0.1 s raised-cosine ramps; whole clip for *_whole and time compression, the latter with a 0.25 s trim)
injection.outcome: per rule, change against the base's control in the defect window: envelope_infeasible_share (detected if >= +0.10, as v1), hover_share and penetration_share (depth-detected if >= +0.10), residual rms, foot skate share

moco_test.false_alarm: mean over the 12 test references of envelope_infeasible_share over scored frames, per rule
moco_test.agreement: vertical GRF r and RMSE / BW against Moco, contact agreement with Moco sphere force > 20 N, per rule
moco_test.v1: the same references are also scored with v1 (answers whether v1 false-alarms on dynamically consistent motion)

pass_criteria.note: 约定，未经推演; primary rule R0; R4 and R5 reported; not met -> reported as is, nothing is changed afterwards

static_detection_min.subset: truth infeasible, support exists, margin <= -0.05 m

rescore.sets: e4, x3, m1 (after ARDY-fair finishes), e1
rescore.inputs: each finished run's coordinates.mot and model.osim (no IK rerun)
rescore.per_run: R0 / R4 / R5 under v2 with the registered tau: envelope share, residual rms, depth quantities; REBA r3 certain-acceptable share gated by the v2 envelope through a shadow directory per rule
rescore.comparisons: the v1 comparisons of each set (as in python/scripts/analyze_e_domain.py bracket contrasts), recomputed with v2 metrics
rescore.consistency: a comparison is a conclusion under a version if its 95% CI excludes 0; v1-v2 table: same-sign conclusion under both, conclusion under one only, null under both, opposite-sign conclusions
